meta.title: Mohammadreza Naderi Akhormeh — Resume & Portfolio
meta.description: Computer Engineering Student at University of Yasuj specializing in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Robotics.

profile.name: Mohammadreza Naderi Akhormeh
profile.headline: Computer Engineering Student
bio: Computer Engineering student at the University of Yasuj with a strong passion for artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, and intelligent robotic systems.
Experienced in programming, academic teaching assistance, and modern web development, with a committed interest in applying AI techniques to solve complex real-world problems.
Seeking to deepen expertise in AI and robotics through graduate studies and innovative research initiatives.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering
highlights: Achieved a top GPA of 18.39/20 across completed semesters.
Recognized as the top-ranking academic student among 77 peers in the 2023 entry cohort.
Served as a Teaching Assistant in foundational programming courses.

awards.title: First-Ranked Student in Computer Engineering
awards.description: Ranked 1st among 77 students in the 2023 Computer Engineering admission cohort at the University of Yasouj, awarded based on outstanding academic performance.

awards.title: Membership in the Iran National Elites Foundation
awards.description: Participating in the 9th Edition of the Problem-Oriented Research and Technology Core Groups Program through the research project entitled 'Protecting Natural Areas Using Artificial Intelligence and Satellite Remote Sensing Imagery.'

experience.summary: Building modern, scalable web applications and robust server-side APIs.
bullets: Developed and maintained website backends using PHP and the Laravel framework.
Implemented secure server-side business logic, authentication, and RESTful APIs based on client project requirements.
Optimized relational database queries and backend workflows for speed and reliability.

experience.role: Teaching Assistant – Fundamentals of Computer & Programming
experience.summary: Mentored undergraduate engineering students in programming fundamentals and algorithmic thinking.
bullets: Served as an official teaching assistant for two consecutive academic semesters.
Guided students through core programming paradigms, memory management, and algorithmic problem-solving techniques.
Supervised hands-on coding lab sessions, graded assignments, and conducted one-on-one debugging support.

projects.title: Graph Routing & Visualization Application
projects.description: A comprehensive graphical application for graph representation, route finding, and interactive pathfinding visualization between nodes.
bullets: Designed and implemented graph data structures with flexible node-edge representations.
Integrated shortest-path and search algorithms to compute optimal routes between arbitrary network nodes.
Provided an intuitive graphical interface for visualizing graph topologies and real-time path exploration.

projects.title: People Clothing Segmentation Using Deep Learning
projects.description: A deep learning computer vision model developed to perform semantic segmentation of clothing garments in human photography.
bullets: Built and trained a semantic segmentation pipeline to accurately isolate clothing regions.
Achieved 87% validation accuracy during rigorous model evaluation benchmarks.
Applied data augmentation, mask preprocessing, and loss function tuning for robust pixel-level classification.

projects.title: Autonomous Turtle Control & Target Tracking Using ROS 2
projects.description: An autonomous robotic tracking and pursuit system implemented in ROS 2 utilizing the Turtlesim environment.
bullets: Developed custom ROS 2 nodes for closed-loop robotic control and real-time trajectory steering.
Implemented proactive target-tracking algorithms to intercept dynamically spawning target coordinates.
Demonstrated modular ROS 2 architecture: nodes, publishers, subscribers, custom services, and launch files.

projects.title: Numerical Simulation of Heat Distribution
projects.description: An interactive numerical simulation of partial differential equations (2D Heat Diffusion Equation) running smoothly in the web browser.
bullets: Formulated the 2D heat equation via finite-difference numerical discretization.
Engineered an interactive browser-based visualization displaying temperature gradients over discrete time steps.
Enabled user configuration of boundary conditions and thermal conductivity parameters.
